title: $1 Res! 360 Pokémon Cards Black Binder | WOTC Japanese Mid Era Topps
description:
^^ Please watch the video to see all pages ^^

CLEARANCE

Large Pokémon card clearout lot presented in a **black 9-pocket binder**, containing approximately **360 cards**.
The binder has **20 9-pocket pages**, with cards displayed front and back for approximately **18 cards per page**.
This lot has a strong mix of older and more unusual Pokémon cards, including:
* **WOTC vintage Pokémon cards**
* **Japanese Pokémon cards**
* **Mid-era cards**
* **Topps Pokémon cards**
* **Modern Pokémon cards**
* Rares, holos, promos and other interesting cards throughout
There is a wide variety of Pokémon, sets and eras represented. A good mixed clearout binder for someone who enjoys sorting through older collections or wants a large selection of cards in one go.
### IMPORTANT – CONDITION
Please assume **ALL cards are Heavily Played or Damaged**.
Condition varies significantly throughout the binder. Cards may have heavy edge wear, creasing, scratches, bends, staining, peeling, writing ...
